children: Shares of newly listed edtech company PhysicsWallah Ltd. will be in focus on Monday, November 16, as a significant part of its outstanding equity will free up from lock-in today.
According to Nuvama Alternative & Quantitative Research, as many as 1,489 million (148.9 crore) equity shares of PhysicsWallah will free up for trade today as its one-year shareholder lock-in ends.
The number of shares that free up for trade, amount to 52% of the company's outstanding equity.
Based on Friday's closing price, the total value of shares that free up for trade on the lock-in ending is worth ₹19,505 crore.
It must be noted that the end of the shareholder lock-in period does not mean all the shares will be sold in the open market. They only become eligible to be traded.

PhysicsWallah had made its stock market debut on November 18, 2025. The stock had listed at ₹145, a 33% premium to its issue price of ₹109 per share. However, subsequent selling dragged the stock down to a post listing low of ₹77.72, which was well below its issue price. The stock, however, since then, has recovered from those levels and now trades above its issue price, but below its post-listing high of ₹161.99.

During the September quarter, PhysicsWallah reported a net profit of ₹144 crore, which is double the ₹70 crore it reported during the same quarter last year. Revenue from operations also grew by 18.2% from last year to ₹1,242 crore.
At the end of the September quarter, promoters of PhysicsWallah held a 71.17% stake in the company, with both Prateek Boob and Alakh Pandey owning a 35.59% stake each.

Among public shareholders, Mutual Funds had a 7% stake in the company, while Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) had a 6.98% stake, of which Westbridge AIF I had a 5.36% stake. Foreign Portfolio Investors held a 10.68% stake in the company.

Retail shareholding in PhysicsWallah is negligible, with 1.73 lakh small shareholders, or those with an authorized share capital of up to ₹2 lakh, held a 1.91% stake at the end of the September quarter.
Shares of PhysicsWallah ended 2% higher on Friday at ₹131.25. The stock's recovery from its post-listing lows has trimmed its year-to-date losses down to 1%.

title: PhysicsWallah shares worth over ₹19,000 crore free up today as major shareholder lock-in ends
